dict.string: EasyFind reads the titles and URLs of your open Chrome tabs to save them as bookmarks, and can open iTerm2 at a folder you choose. It never modifies your browser or terminal data.
EasyFind indexes file names in the folders you configure so you can search them from the launcher. File contents are never read.
